title: speech_transcript_ready
description: Published by the speech worker when ASR, alignment, and diff classification finish for a recitation test (Handbook §9.2/§9.3). Consumed by the memorisation (hfz) context. Transcript and error-list bodies stay in object storage — the event carries references only (R7). schema_version 1.

test_id.description: Recitation test this result belongs to.

transcript_ref.description: Object-storage reference to the aligned transcript artifact.

errors_ref.description: Object-storage reference to the classified error-list artifact (§13.3 taxonomy). Absent when the recitation had no detected errors.

wer.description: Word error rate of the recitation against the canonical range.

model_version.description: ASR model identifier used, for benchmark traceability (§23 speech bench).
